function.name: calculator
function.description: Evaluate a plain arithmetic expression.

function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search the facts Jarvis has learned about the owner. For the owner's own notes, use notes_search. For the public web, use web_search.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read a local text file.

function.name: shell_exec
function.description: Run one shell command on this machine and return its output.

function.name: control_computer
function.description: Click or type in another Windows program by naming its on-screen controls. A control that cannot be found is reported, not guessed.

function.name: control_phone
function.description: Tap, swipe, type, press a key or take a screenshot on the owner's paired Android phone.

function.name: github_search
function.description: Check GitHub for an existing library for a coding idea, graded by maintenance and licence. For a general web search, use web_search.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the public web for current or outside information. Returns up to 5 results: title, link, snippet. Use a few plain search words; never put private details in them. For what Jarvis knows about the owner, use memory_search. For the owner's own notes, use notes_search. To grade GitHub libraries for a coding idea, use github_search.

function.name: calendar_read
function.description: Read the owner's calendar events for the next N days. Read-only. For messages, use email_check.

function.name: email_check
function.description: Read recent messages in the owner's inbox: sender, subject, date, preview. Read-only; never sends. For appointments and events, use calendar_read. To send one, use send_email.

function.name: send_email
function.description: Send one plain-text email from the owner's account. The owner sees all of it on an approval card first; nothing is sent without their yes. No attachments. To read the inbox, use email_check.

body.description: the whole email, as it will be sent

function.name: notes_search
function.description: Search the owner's own notes (Obsidian or Joplin). Read-only. For facts Jarvis remembers about the owner, use memory_search. For the public web, use web_search.

function.name: home_read
function.description: Read the state of named Home Assistant entities. Read-only. To change something, use home_control.

function.name: home_control
function.description: Call one Home Assistant service on one entity, e.g. turn a light on or unlock a door. Changes something real. To only check a state, use home_read.

function.name: append_logseq_journal
function.description: Add one entry to today's Logseq journal page. Only adds.

function.name: append_obsidian_daily
function.description: Add one entry to today's Obsidian daily note. Only adds. For a separate note with its own title, use create_joplin_note.

function.name: create_joplin_note
function.description: Create one new note in Joplin. Never edits a note or makes a notebook. To add to today's daily note, use append_obsidian_daily.

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Start a countdown timer on this PC.

function.name: set_reminder
function.description: Set a reminder or alarm on this PC, once or repeating. `when` is plain English, e.g. "tomorrow at 6pm" or "in 20 minutes". A repeat waits for the owner's yes on a card.

text.description: what to remind the owner of, in their words

function.name: todo_add
function.description: Add one item to the owner's to-do list on this PC.

function.name: todo_done
function.description: Mark one item on the owner's to-do list as done.

item.description: the item's words, or enough of them

function.name: coming_up
function.description: List the owner's timers, alarms, reminders and to-do list on this PC.
